Inline enum values:

### `flat_memory`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `paged` | Paging supported; at least upper page 03h is implemented |
| 0x01 | `flat` | Flat memory; lower memory and upper page 00h only |

### `interrupt_deasserted`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `asserted` | IntL asserted |
| 0x01 | `not_asserted` | IntL not asserted |

### `data_not_ready`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `monitor_data_valid` | Valid monitor data can be read |
| 0x01 | `monitor_data_not_ready` | Free-side device does not yet have valid monitor data |

### `temp_mon_alarm_warning_flag`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `high_alarm` | High temperature alarm |
| 0x01 | `low_alarm` | Low temperature alarm |
| 0x02 | `high_warning` | High temperature warning |
| 0x03 | `low_warning` | Low temperature warning |

### `vcc_mon_alarm_warning_flag`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `high_alarm` | High supply voltage alarm |
| 0x01 | `low_alarm` | Low supply voltage alarm |
| 0x02 | `high_warning` | High supply voltage warning |
| 0x03 | `low_warning` | Low supply voltage warning |

### `advanced_low_power_mode`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `no_below_1p5w_limit` | Power limit below 1.5 W is not available |
| 0x01 | `no_more_than_1w` | No more than 1 W |
| 0x02 | `no_more_than_0p75w` | No more than 0.75 W |
| 0x03 | `no_more_than_0p5w` | No more than 0.5 W |
| 4..15 | `reserved` | Reserved |

### `min_operating_voltage`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `vcc_3p3` | Nominal 3.3 V |
| 0x01 | `vcc_2p5` | Nominal 2.5 V |
| 0x02 | `vcc_1p8` | Nominal 1.8 V |
| 3..7 | `reserved` | Reserved |

### `far_end_implementation`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `unspecified` | Far end is unspecified |
| 0x01 | `single_far_end_four_channels` | Single far end with four channels |
| 0x02 | `single_far_end_two_channels` | Single far end with two channels |
| 0x03 | `single_far_end_one_channel` | Single far end with one channel |
| 0x04 | `four_by_one_breakout` | Four far ends with one channel each |
| 0x05 | `two_by_two_breakout` | Two far ends with two channels each |
| 0x06 | `two_by_one_breakout` | Two far ends with one channel each |
| 0x07 | `reserved` | Reserved |

Inline enum values:

#### `flat_memory`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `paged` | Paging supported; at least upper page 03h is implemented |
| 0x01 | `flat` | Flat memory; lower memory and upper page 00h only |

#### `interrupt_deasserted`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `asserted` | IntL asserted |
| 0x01 | `not_asserted` | IntL not asserted |

#### `data_not_ready`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `monitor_data_valid` | Valid monitor data can be read |
| 0x01 | `monitor_data_not_ready` | Free-side device does not yet have valid monitor data |

#### `temp_mon_alarm_warning_flag`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `high_alarm` | High temperature alarm |
| 0x01 | `low_alarm` | Low temperature alarm |
| 0x02 | `high_warning` | High temperature warning |
| 0x03 | `low_warning` | Low temperature warning |

#### `vcc_mon_alarm_warning_flag`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `high_alarm` | High supply voltage alarm |
| 0x01 | `low_alarm` | Low supply voltage alarm |
| 0x02 | `high_warning` | High supply voltage warning |
| 0x03 | `low_warning` | Low supply voltage warning |

#### `advanced_low_power_mode`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `no_below_1p5w_limit` | Power limit below 1.5 W is not available |
| 0x01 | `no_more_than_1w` | No more than 1 W |
| 0x02 | `no_more_than_0p75w` | No more than 0.75 W |
| 0x03 | `no_more_than_0p5w` | No more than 0.5 W |
| 4..15 | `reserved` | Reserved |

#### `min_operating_voltage`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `vcc_3p3` | Nominal 3.3 V |
| 0x01 | `vcc_2p5` | Nominal 2.5 V |
| 0x02 | `vcc_1p8` | Nominal 1.8 V |
| 3..7 | `reserved` | Reserved |

Inline enum values:

#### `flat_memory`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `paged` | Paging supported; at least upper page 03h is implemented |
| 0x01 | `flat` | Flat memory; lower memory and upper page 00h only |

#### `interrupt_deasserted`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `asserted` | IntL asserted |
| 0x01 | `not_asserted` | IntL not asserted |

#### `data_not_ready`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `monitor_data_valid` | Valid monitor data can be read |
| 0x01 | `monitor_data_not_ready` | Free-side device does not yet have valid monitor data |

#### `temp_mon_alarm_warning_flag`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `high_alarm` | High temperature alarm |
| 0x01 | `low_alarm` | Low temperature alarm |
| 0x02 | `high_warning` | High temperature warning |
| 0x03 | `low_warning` | Low temperature warning |

#### `vcc_mon_alarm_warning_flag`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `high_alarm` | High supply voltage alarm |
| 0x01 | `low_alarm` | Low supply voltage alarm |
| 0x02 | `high_warning` | High supply voltage warning |
| 0x03 | `low_warning` | Low supply voltage warning |

#### `advanced_low_power_mode`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `no_below_1p5w_limit` | Power limit below 1.5 W is not available |
| 0x01 | `no_more_than_1w` | No more than 1 W |
| 0x02 | `no_more_than_0p75w` | No more than 0.75 W |
| 0x03 | `no_more_than_0p5w` | No more than 0.5 W |
| 4..15 | `reserved` | Reserved |

#### `min_operating_voltage`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `vcc_3p3` | Nominal 3.3 V |
| 0x01 | `vcc_2p5` | Nominal 2.5 V |
| 0x02 | `vcc_1p8` | Nominal 1.8 V |
| 3..7 | `reserved` | Reserved |

Inline enum values:

#### `flat_memory`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `paged` | Paging supported; at least upper page 03h is implemented |
| 0x01 | `flat` | Flat memory; lower memory and upper page 00h only |

#### `interrupt_deasserted`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `asserted` | IntL asserted |
| 0x01 | `not_asserted` | IntL not asserted |

#### `data_not_ready`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `monitor_data_valid` | Valid monitor data can be read |
| 0x01 | `monitor_data_not_ready` | Free-side device does not yet have valid monitor data |

#### `temp_mon_alarm_warning_flag`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `high_alarm` | High temperature alarm |
| 0x01 | `low_alarm` | Low temperature alarm |
| 0x02 | `high_warning` | High temperature warning |
| 0x03 | `low_warning` | Low temperature warning |

#### `vcc_mon_alarm_warning_flag`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `high_alarm` | High supply voltage alarm |
| 0x01 | `low_alarm` | Low supply voltage alarm |
| 0x02 | `high_warning` | High supply voltage warning |
| 0x03 | `low_warning` | Low supply voltage warning |

#### `advanced_low_power_mode`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `no_below_1p5w_limit` | Power limit below 1.5 W is not available |
| 0x01 | `no_more_than_1w` | No more than 1 W |
| 0x02 | `no_more_than_0p75w` | No more than 0.75 W |
| 0x03 | `no_more_than_0p5w` | No more than 0.5 W |
| 4..15 | `reserved` | Reserved |

#### `min_operating_voltage`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `vcc_3p3` | Nominal 3.3 V |
| 0x01 | `vcc_2p5` | Nominal 2.5 V |
| 0x02 | `vcc_1p8` | Nominal 1.8 V |
| 3..7 | `reserved` | Reserved |

Inline enum values:

#### `flat_memory`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `paged` | Paging supported; at least upper page 03h is implemented |
| 0x01 | `flat` | Flat memory; lower memory and upper page 00h only |

#### `interrupt_deasserted`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `asserted` | IntL asserted |
| 0x01 | `not_asserted` | IntL not asserted |

#### `data_not_ready`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `monitor_data_valid` | Valid monitor data can be read |
| 0x01 | `monitor_data_not_ready` | Free-side device does not yet have valid monitor data |

#### `temp_mon_alarm_warning_flag`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `high_alarm` | High temperature alarm |
| 0x01 | `low_alarm` | Low temperature alarm |
| 0x02 | `high_warning` | High temperature warning |
| 0x03 | `low_warning` | Low temperature warning |

#### `vcc_mon_alarm_warning_flag`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `high_alarm` | High supply voltage alarm |
| 0x01 | `low_alarm` | Low supply voltage alarm |
| 0x02 | `high_warning` | High supply voltage warning |
| 0x03 | `low_warning` | Low supply voltage warning |

#### `advanced_low_power_mode`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `no_below_1p5w_limit` | Power limit below 1.5 W is not available |
| 0x01 | `no_more_than_1w` | No more than 1 W |
| 0x02 | `no_more_than_0p75w` | No more than 0.75 W |
| 0x03 | `no_more_than_0p5w` | No more than 0.5 W |
| 4..15 | `reserved` | Reserved |

#### `min_operating_voltage`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `vcc_3p3` | Nominal 3.3 V |
| 0x01 | `vcc_2p5` | Nominal 2.5 V |
| 0x02 | `vcc_1p8` | Nominal 1.8 V |
| 3..7 | `reserved` | Reserved |

Inline enum values:

#### `flat_memory`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `paged` | Paging supported; at least upper page 03h is implemented |
| 0x01 | `flat` | Flat memory; lower memory and upper page 00h only |

#### `interrupt_deasserted`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `asserted` | IntL asserted |
| 0x01 | `not_asserted` | IntL not asserted |

#### `data_not_ready`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `monitor_data_valid` | Valid monitor data can be read |
| 0x01 | `monitor_data_not_ready` | Free-side device does not yet have valid monitor data |

#### `temp_mon_alarm_warning_flag`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `high_alarm` | High temperature alarm |
| 0x01 | `low_alarm` | Low temperature alarm |
| 0x02 | `high_warning` | High temperature warning |
| 0x03 | `low_warning` | Low temperature warning |

#### `vcc_mon_alarm_warning_flag`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `high_alarm` | High supply voltage alarm |
| 0x01 | `low_alarm` | Low supply voltage alarm |
| 0x02 | `high_warning` | High supply voltage warning |
| 0x03 | `low_warning` | Low supply voltage warning |

#### `advanced_low_power_mode`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `no_below_1p5w_limit` | Power limit below 1.5 W is not available |
| 0x01 | `no_more_than_1w` | No more than 1 W |
| 0x02 | `no_more_than_0p75w` | No more than 0.75 W |
| 0x03 | `no_more_than_0p5w` | No more than 0.5 W |
| 4..15 | `reserved` | Reserved |

#### `min_operating_voltage`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `vcc_3p3` | Nominal 3.3 V |
| 0x01 | `vcc_2p5` | Nominal 2.5 V |
| 0x02 | `vcc_1p8` | Nominal 1.8 V |
| 3..7 | `reserved` | Reserved |

#### `far_end_implementation`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `unspecified` | Far end is unspecified |
| 0x01 | `single_far_end_four_channels` | Single far end with four channels |
| 0x02 | `single_far_end_two_channels` | Single far end with two channels |
| 0x03 | `single_far_end_one_channel` | Single far end with one channel |
| 0x04 | `four_by_one_breakout` | Four far ends with one channel each |
| 0x05 | `two_by_two_breakout` | Two far ends with two channels each |
| 0x06 | `two_by_one_breakout` | Two far ends with one channel each |
| 0x07 | `reserved` | Reserved |

Inline enum values:

#### `flat_memory`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `paged` | Paging supported; at least upper page 03h is implemented |
| 0x01 | `flat` | Flat memory; lower memory and upper page 00h only |

#### `interrupt_deasserted`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `asserted` | IntL asserted |
| 0x01 | `not_asserted` | IntL not asserted |

#### `data_not_ready`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `monitor_data_valid` | Valid monitor data can be read |
| 0x01 | `monitor_data_not_ready` | Free-side device does not yet have valid monitor data |

#### `temp_mon_alarm_warning_flag`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `high_alarm` | High temperature alarm |
| 0x01 | `low_alarm` | Low temperature alarm |
| 0x02 | `high_warning` | High temperature warning |
| 0x03 | `low_warning` | Low temperature warning |

#### `vcc_mon_alarm_warning_flag`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `high_alarm` | High supply voltage alarm |
| 0x01 | `low_alarm` | Low supply voltage alarm |
| 0x02 | `high_warning` | High supply voltage warning |
| 0x03 | `low_warning` | Low supply voltage warning |

#### `advanced_low_power_mode`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `no_below_1p5w_limit` | Power limit below 1.5 W is not available |
| 0x01 | `no_more_than_1w` | No more than 1 W |
| 0x02 | `no_more_than_0p75w` | No more than 0.75 W |
| 0x03 | `no_more_than_0p5w` | No more than 0.5 W |
| 4..15 | `reserved` | Reserved |

#### `min_operating_voltage`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `vcc_3p3` | Nominal 3.3 V |
| 0x01 | `vcc_2p5` | Nominal 2.5 V |
| 0x02 | `vcc_1p8` | Nominal 1.8 V |
| 3..7 | `reserved` | Reserved |

#### `far_end_implementation`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `unspecified` | Far end is unspecified |
| 0x01 | `single_far_end_four_channels` | Single far end with four channels |
| 0x02 | `single_far_end_two_channels` | Single far end with two channels |
| 0x03 | `single_far_end_one_channel` | Single far end with one channel |
| 0x04 | `four_by_one_breakout` | Four far ends with one channel each |
| 0x05 | `two_by_two_breakout` | Two far ends with two channels each |
| 0x06 | `two_by_one_breakout` | Two far ends with one channel each |
| 0x07 | `reserved` | Reserved |

Inline enum values:

#### `flat_memory`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `paged` | Paging supported; at least upper page 03h is implemented |
| 0x01 | `flat` | Flat memory; lower memory and upper page 00h only |

#### `interrupt_deasserted`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `asserted` | IntL asserted |
| 0x01 | `not_asserted` | IntL not asserted |

#### `data_not_ready`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `monitor_data_valid` | Valid monitor data can be read |
| 0x01 | `monitor_data_not_ready` | Free-side device does not yet have valid monitor data |

#### `temp_mon_alarm_warning_flag`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `high_alarm` | High temperature alarm |
| 0x01 | `low_alarm` | Low temperature alarm |
| 0x02 | `high_warning` | High temperature warning |
| 0x03 | `low_warning` | Low temperature warning |

#### `vcc_mon_alarm_warning_flag`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `high_alarm` | High supply voltage alarm |
| 0x01 | `low_alarm` | Low supply voltage alarm |
| 0x02 | `high_warning` | High supply voltage warning |
| 0x03 | `low_warning` | Low supply voltage warning |

#### `advanced_low_power_mode`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `no_below_1p5w_limit` | Power limit below 1.5 W is not available |
| 0x01 | `no_more_than_1w` | No more than 1 W |
| 0x02 | `no_more_than_0p75w` | No more than 0.75 W |
| 0x03 | `no_more_than_0p5w` | No more than 0.5 W |
| 4..15 | `reserved` | Reserved |

#### `min_operating_voltage`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `vcc_3p3` | Nominal 3.3 V |
| 0x01 | `vcc_2p5` | Nominal 2.5 V |
| 0x02 | `vcc_1p8` | Nominal 1.8 V |
| 3..7 | `reserved` | Reserved |

#### `far_end_implementation`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `unspecified` | Far end is unspecified |
| 0x01 | `single_far_end_four_channels` | Single far end with four channels |
| 0x02 | `single_far_end_two_channels` | Single far end with two channels |
| 0x03 | `single_far_end_one_channel` | Single far end with one channel |
| 0x04 | `four_by_one_breakout` | Four far ends with one channel each |
| 0x05 | `two_by_two_breakout` | Two far ends with two channels each |
| 0x06 | `two_by_one_breakout` | Two far ends with one channel each |
| 0x07 | `reserved` | Reserved |

Inline enum values:

#### `flat_memory`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `paged` | Paging supported; at least upper page 03h is implemented |
| 0x01 | `flat` | Flat memory; lower memory and upper page 00h only |

#### `interrupt_deasserted`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `asserted` | IntL asserted |
| 0x01 | `not_asserted` | IntL not asserted |

#### `data_not_ready`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `monitor_data_valid` | Valid monitor data can be read |
| 0x01 | `monitor_data_not_ready` | Free-side device does not yet have valid monitor data |

#### `temp_mon_alarm_warning_flag`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `high_alarm` | High temperature alarm |
| 0x01 | `low_alarm` | Low temperature alarm |
| 0x02 | `high_warning` | High temperature warning |
| 0x03 | `low_warning` | Low temperature warning |

#### `vcc_mon_alarm_warning_flag`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `high_alarm` | High supply voltage alarm |
| 0x01 | `low_alarm` | Low supply voltage alarm |
| 0x02 | `high_warning` | High supply voltage warning |
| 0x03 | `low_warning` | Low supply voltage warning |

#### `advanced_low_power_mode`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `no_below_1p5w_limit` | Power limit below 1.5 W is not available |
| 0x01 | `no_more_than_1w` | No more than 1 W |
| 0x02 | `no_more_than_0p75w` | No more than 0.75 W |
| 0x03 | `no_more_than_0p5w` | No more than 0.5 W |
| 4..15 | `reserved` | Reserved |

#### `min_operating_voltage`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `vcc_3p3` | Nominal 3.3 V |
| 0x01 | `vcc_2p5` | Nominal 2.5 V |
| 0x02 | `vcc_1p8` | Nominal 1.8 V |
| 3..7 | `reserved` | Reserved |

#### `far_end_implementation`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `unspecified` | Far end is unspecified |
| 0x01 | `single_far_end_four_channels` | Single far end with four channels |
| 0x02 | `single_far_end_two_channels` | Single far end with two channels |
| 0x03 | `single_far_end_one_channel` | Single far end with one channel |
| 0x04 | `four_by_one_breakout` | Four far ends with one channel each |
| 0x05 | `two_by_two_breakout` | Two far ends with two channels each |
| 0x06 | `two_by_one_breakout` | Two far ends with one channel each |
| 0x07 | `reserved` | Reserved |
